My name  is Jesper, and I am an addict. I am living in Denmark and when I lost my job, because of illnes, the social took over and helped me, with money, so I did not lost my apartment. But here in Denmark we are paying a lot in taxes, and it is the reason why we get free education, hospitals, and much help from our state. I pay mi tax with gratitute and that is one of the big difference, between USA and many countries in Europe. 
Whats happening for those many poor addicts in USA, can of course also be a problem here in Denmark, but there are always help to the addicts who want the help. Every addict can get free methadone, ore other kind of midical help, and again, if they want. But as many other countries the hardest help to get, is a place to stay. So it makes me very sad to see all these human beings, live like that in the richest country in the world. It is only the politicians who can change the laws, and by that help these addicts who really dont have to live like that. Shame on you all american politicians.
